annotations.title: Get my share in a rikma

description: The user's share in one of their rikmas, and every member's share, exactly as the rikma's split page computes them: value from finished missions (approved hours x rate), resources the rikma received, and confirmed stipend payments - with the missions and resources behind each share. Members only. Read-only; it shows no sales or profit-split figures. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getMyStakeTool
name: getMyStakeTool
